ValidationRule.description: Prevents the retained Portal User compatibility lookups from contradicting Employees__c during migration.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Employee__c)), Employee__c <> Employees__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Portal_Users__c)), Portal_Users__c <> Employees__c) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Legacy Portal User relationships must match the transition Portal User field.
